services.name: Parasail flights
services.desc: Our parasail season runs May 16 through December 14. We shut down for the winter - not for weather, but because thousands of humpback whales arrive in the channel. Here's how to plan around it, and what to do if you're here in the off-season. Maui Whale Adventures runs December 1 to April 1 - so the two seasons overlap by a couple of weeks. Cyan months are parasail months; gold months are whale-watching months with our sister boat. The seasons overlap: parasailing runs May 16 to December 14, whale tours December 1 to April 1. services.name: Snorkel Lānaʻi
services.desc: Most snorkel tours out of West Maui carry sixty people to the same two spots. This one carries fourteen on a fast, shallow-draft raft, which means the crew can pick the day's stops on conditions rather than on what the schedule allows - sea caves, lava arches and reef along Lānaʻi's largely undeveloped coast. Guides get in the water with you. That's the difference people mention most: someone alongside pointing out what you'd otherwise swim past - honu, octopus, eels, the occasional pod of spinner dolphins on the crossing. blurb: Guests fly solo, tandem, or triple on a parasail with dry takeoff and landing from a boat. Flights last 8 to 14 minutes in the air, with the whole trip about an hour including shuttle from the beach. The operation runs May 16 to December 14, with USCG-certified captains and safety equipment.

quotes.text: The crew was friendly, professional, and made us feel safe the entire time. The views of Kaʻanapali Beach were absolutely incredible.
We had an unforgettable time. The launch and landing were smooth, and the scenery was stunning.
